gap_rule: Windows inside the declared AIS window with no usable position report. leading: window start to first fix; internal: consecutive fixes more than 2 x the track's median step apart; trailing: last fix to window end; no_fixes: no usable fix in the window. A sentinel position counts as missing. No position reported is missing evidence, not proof of an outage.
display_rule: Centripetal Catmull-Rom (alpha 0.5) through the usable fixes, 3 points inserted per step, never across a gap. For rendering only; every analysis uses the original fixes with straight-line interpolation.
